name: Test grid
about: M2's flat test world: sea level everywhere, grass except one paved runway along north–south at the origin.

starts.name: Runway
starts.about: at rest on the south end of the runway's centreline, heading north, ready to roll (airplanes with an engine)

starts.name: High
starts.about: 1,000 m above the south end of the runway, heading north

starts.name: Circuit
starts.about: 300 m on a left-hand downwind for runway 36: abeam the runway's middle, 600 m to the west, heading south

starts.name: Final
starts.about: 100 m up on a 2 km straight-in final to runway 36: 2 km before the threshold, a 2.9° glidepath
